name.value: Talking Rock Golf and Quaaout Lodge

description.value: Quaaout Lodge & Spa at Talking Rock Golf Resort is an Indigenous-owned resort on the shores of Little Shuswap Lake, developed by the Skwlāx te Secwepemcúl̓ecw (Little Shuswap Lake Band) and opened in 1991. The property features the Talking Rock Golf Course, Jack Sam's Restaurant, and is situated near the Adams River salmon run and Tsútswecw Provincial Park. A May 2022 fire destroyed the guest room wing; a rebuild is committed to but accommodation is not currently available.

address.value: 1663 Little Shuswap Lake Road, Chase, BC V0E 1M2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the physical location, contact details, and that the golf course and restaurant are open. However, the /stay/ subpage explicitly states the entire guest room wing was destroyed by fire on May 22, 2022, and 'We will not be booking any stays at the lodge until we rebuild our guest room wing.' Because there is no functioning accommodation, bike storage and all accommodation-related amenities are unverifiable. The Jack Sam's Restaurant is confirmed open on-site, supporting 'Nearby evening food' as true for a cyclist visiting the area.
concerns: Guest room wing was destroyed by fire on May 22, 2022; no overnight stays are being booked as of the website content.
Le7ke Spa is listed as 'CLOSED PERMANENTLY UNTIL QUAAOUT LODGE REBUILD' as of October 13, 2025.
Category is 'Accommodation' but accommodation is currently unavailable; only golf and restaurant are operational.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The property physically exists and the golf course and restaurant are open, but the accommodation wing was destroyed by fire in May 2022 and the lodge states it is not accepting overnight stays pending a rebuild. As an 'Accommodation' listing it cannot currently fulfil that role; include once rebuild is confirmed complete.
enrichment_extras.notes: The resort has committed to rebuilding the accommodation wing. Email for rebuild updates: gm@quaaoutlodge.com. Toll-free number: 1 (800) 663-4303.
